name: APRI Score
description: AST-to-Platelet Ratio Index for fibrosis assessment
template:
APRI Score (AST-to-Platelet Ratio Index)

Simple fibrosis marker - especially useful in hepatitis C

Normal: 10-40 U/L
Usually 40 U/L (check your lab's reference)
Normal: 150-400 ×10⁹/L
Formula: APRI = [(AST / AST ULN) / Platelets (10⁹/L)] × 100
For Significant Fibrosis (≥F2):
• <0.5: Rules out (NPV 86%)
• >1.5: Rules in (PPV 88%)
For Cirrhosis (F4):
• <1.0: Rules out (NPV 91%)
• >2.0: Rules in (PPV 65%)
Reference: Wai CT et al. Hepatology 2003
